topics.title: My Games hub
topics.answer: You're on the My Games hub. Tap any game card to play. Use the top buttons for Achievements, Leaderboards, Friends, Players, Updates, Feedback, and Settings. Search games with the search box. Press F anytime for this Help Assistant (F1 inside letter games).

topics.title: How to play (hub)
topics.answer: Pick a minigame from the grid. Each game has its own rules — open Help (?) again after you enter a game for that game's instructions. On the hub you can also check achievements, high scores, leaderboards, and settings.

topics.title: Where are achievements?
topics.answer: On the hub home screen, tap 🏆 Achievements. Unlocks sync with your player name across games. Many games toast a popup when you earn one mid-run.

topics.title: Where are options / settings?
topics.answer: On the hub, tap ⚙ Settings (top of the games screen) for look themes, sound, and account options. Inside some games (like Fishing Idle), use the in-game Settings / ⚙ button for game-specific options.

topics.title: Leaderboards
topics.answer: On the hub, tap Leaderboards, then pick a game or hub board (Hub Points, Day Streak, etc.). Set a unique player name so your scores can sync. High Scores on the hub shows your personal bests.

topics.title: Friends, chat & online
topics.answer: Set a player name on the hub first. Friends and chat are on the hub panels. Hold Tab on most pages to peek at who's online. Calls use the hub call tools when friends are available.

topics.title: Username & player code
topics.answer: Ask Help “what is my username?” or “what is my player code?” to see the values saved on this device. Find them anytime in Hub → Settings. Passwords are never shown by Help.

topics.title: Who owns My Games?
topics.answer: The owner of My Games is ICE_DRAGON.

topics.title: Updates & patches
topics.answer: Open the hub and tap Updates to see What's New for each build. Fresh notes also show when the hub loads after a new release.

topics.title: Player counts & live stats
topics.answer: Help chat can't pull exact live database stats. Check Players and Leaderboards on the hub, hold Tab to see who's online, or ask in Discord for the latest community numbers.

topics.title: Something broken?
topics.answer: Try a hard refresh, make sure you're on the latest build (check Updates), and confirm your username is set. You can also send Feedback from the hub if a bug keeps happening.

topics.title: Common controls
topics.answer: ☰ Menu (or Esc) pauses most action games. Games returns to the hub. Help: press F (or F1 in letter games like Guessword), or tap the ? button. Exact move/shoot keys depend on the current minigame — ask “how to play” while inside that game.

topics.title: Help Assistant
topics.answer: Tap the ? button (bottom-right) or press F — in Guessword, Hangman, Quiz, and Sudoku use F1 so letter keys stay free. Ask in plain language or use a quick question. Answers come from a local guide — no internet or API key needed.

topics.title: Fair play
topics.answer: Help only shares public rules, controls, and menu directions. It never reveals secret words, hidden tiles, puzzle keys, or other live answers — those you earn by playing.

topics.title: Guessword — How to play
topics.answer: Guess the secret word in 6 tries. After each guess, tiles show correct letter+spot (cyan), wrong spot (purple), or not in the word. Switch Daily (shared word) vs Practice from the badge by the title. Open the hub Games screen to leave Guessword.

topics.title: Space Shooter — How to play
topics.answer: Move with the mouse or WASD. Shoot with Space or click. Dodge enemies and survive as long as you can for a high score. Esc / Menu pauses.

topics.title: Quizmaster — How to play
topics.answer: Answer trivia questions as fast and accurately as you can. Pick the correct choice each round to build your score. Menu pauses / returns you toward the hub.

topics.title: Bounce Break — How to play
topics.answer: Move the paddle to bounce the ball and break all the bricks. Don't let the ball fall past the paddle. Esc / Menu pauses.

topics.title: Hangman — How to play
topics.answer: Guess the hidden word one letter at a time. Wrong letters fill the hangman figure — too many misses and you lose. Use the on-screen letters or your keyboard.

topics.title: Block Merge — How to play
topics.answer: Use arrow keys or swipe to slide all tiles. Matching numbers merge into their sum. Reach 2048 (and beyond). Plan ahead — the board fills when you can't move.

topics.title: Snake — How to play
topics.answer: Use arrow keys or WASD to steer. Eat the apples (there are 4 on the board), grow longer, and don't hit the walls or yourself. Esc / Menu pauses.

topics.title: Memory Match — How to play
topics.answer: Flip cards to find matching pairs. Clear the board in as few moves and as little time as you can for a better score.

topics.title: Drop Four — How to play
topics.answer: Click a column to drop your disc. Connect four in a row — horizontal, vertical, or diagonal — to win.

topics.title: Math Sprint — How to play
topics.answer: Solve arithmetic problems quickly and accurately. Race the clock or beat your best streak depending on the round. Menu returns you toward the hub.

topics.title: Sudoku — How to play
topics.answer: Classic 9×9 logic puzzle. Fill digits so each appears once per row, column, and 3×3 box. Tap a cell, then pick a number.

topics.title: Wing Hop — How to play
topics.answer: Tap, click, or press Space to flap. Fly your dragon through the castle towers without crashing. Esc / Menu pauses.

topics.title: Tic Tac Toe — How to play
topics.answer: Take turns placing X and O on the 3×3 grid. First to get three in a row wins. Play vs a friend or the built-in opponent mode if available.

topics.title: Pixel Drop — How to play
topics.answer: Blocks crumble into sand when they land. Bridge one color from the left wall to the right wall to clear it. Plan drops carefully.

topics.title: Crystal Clicker — How to play
topics.answer: Tap the crystal to earn. Buy Click power upgrades first, then Idle income so you earn while away. Open Menu for pause / hub.

topics.title: Tower Stack 3D — How to play
topics.answer: Time your taps to stack moving blocks into a tower. Perfect placements keep the full size; misses trim the stack. Go as high as you can.

topics.title: Cross Walk — How to play
topics.answer: Cross roads and lanes safely. Move forward for score, dodge traffic and hazards. Esc / Menu pauses.

topics.title: Fishing Idle — How to play
topics.answer: Cast, wait for the bobber to dunk, then time your reel. Fill the cooler, sell fish for coins, and buy rods/gear. Use Menu for Settings, Catch book, Fish guide, Shiny machine, and number-suffix help. Best catches hit the leaderboard.

topics.title: Fishing Idle — Settings
topics.answer: Tap ⚙ or Menu → Settings for master sound, volume, SFX, confetti, storm flash, and chests. Number suffixes (K, M, …) are explained under Menu → Number suffixes.

topics.title: Cow Merge — How to play
topics.answer: Merge matching cows to make stronger ones. Keep making space and climb to higher tiers for a better score.

topics.title: Runosaur — How to play
topics.answer: Run through the cave. Jump crystals and duck bats — stay ahead of the dragon. Space / tap to jump; learn the duck control on the start screen. Esc / Menu pauses.

topics.title: Ramp Rush — How to play
topics.answer: Steer left/right (arrows, A/D, or on-screen) along the track. Hit ramps, avoid voids, and survive for distance. Esc / Menu pauses.

topics.title: Guac-A-Mole — How to play
topics.answer: Whack the avocados / moles as they pop up. Hit the right targets for points — miss or hit bad ones and you'll lose score or lives. Play fast!

topics.title: Bubble Pop Relay — How to play
topics.answer: Pop matching bubble clusters before the rising line swallows the tank. Aim carefully and clear groups to stay alive.

topics.title: Cafe Queue — How to play
topics.answer: Serve drinks and snacks as the line grows. Keep combos alive for bigger tips. Don't let customers wait too long.

topics.title: Garden Snap — How to play
topics.answer: Race through short seasons — plant, water, and harvest for points. Match the season goals before time runs out.

topics.title: Mine Depth — How to play
topics.answer: Dig down through layers to find ore. Sell ore for coins, buy picks/drills/gear (luck, sell, Sync, Crit, Yield, Scout, and more). Auto dig earns while you watch. Use Numbers/Depth menus for suffixes (K, M, … Dc). Layer size shows how thick the current band is.

topics.title: Block Sweep — How to play
topics.answer: Drag colorful blocks onto the 8×8 board. Clear full lines, chain combos, and beat your best score.

topics.title: Dudes — How to play
topics.answer: Green walkers drop from the yellow IN box and walk on their own. Get enough into the green OUT door to clear the level. On later levels: tap a skill, then tap a walker. Cleared levels stay unlocked.

topics.title: Paper Claim — How to play
topics.answer: Paint the map like paper.io — claim territory, cut enemy trails, and survive. Don't get cut while your trail is open.
